messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] cluster-prod-usw2 - gpu-decode pool 'decode-rt-23' reporting multiple CUDA OOMs over last 90s. 12 nodes with repeated OOM, auto-eviction triggered. stack: decode/streaming. severity: P1. paging: true
ashwin: ack-ing. I'm oncall. pulling logs now.
kamal: +1 seeing a huge spike in token output for a small number of sessions. looks like a downstream client is sending header X-allow-unbounded: true? will confirm.
laila: customer impact? any errors surfaced in public status?
ingrid: not yet, CS pinged me: "requests timing out / partial responses" from two customers in EU and USW. they're opening tickets.
ashwin: quick telemetry: 00:00-00:90 window -> GPU mem pressure 92-98%, p99 decode latency from 120ms to 1.9s, request failures ~7% global but 18% for streaming paths. trace id examples: t-ff12ab34.
kamal: reproducing locally with a sample stream: client didn't set max_tokens and server default override didn't apply due to routing bug. runaway generation -> KV growth -> OOM.
ashwin: immediate mitigations I propose: 1) throttle streaming concurrency on decode-rt-23 to 30% 2) enable global token hard-cap header via edge 3) route traffic for model variant 'x-large/v1' away from pool 23 to fallback pool 12 4) patch runtime to enforce server-side max_tokens if header absent.
kevin: I can apply 1 and 2 now. doing: `rbctl pool set-concurrency decode-rt-23 --pct 30`
kevin: done. concurrency lowered.
kevin: applying header override at edge: `edgectl set-default-header X-rl-max-tokens=512`
kevin: done, propagating (may take ~8s).
devops-bot: deploy status: routing change pushed to 8 proxies in us-west-2, 5 in eu-west-1.
laila: observing request drops drop from 18% -> 6% in streaming path within 30s. mem pressure trending down slowly.
ashwin: routing fallback for 'x-large/v1' -> invoking: `rbctl route add --from decode-rt-23 --to fallback-12 --model x-large/v1 --drain 0`
kamal: started to drain tasks off decode-rt-23, but noticed two nodes flapped with repeated container restarts. suspect kernel OOM killer or driver-level CUDA failures. grabbing dmesg.
ashwin: patch: we'll cordon nodes showing kernel OOM and kick off node-level reprovision. `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23a` `kubectl drain gpu-node-23a --ignore-daemonsets --force`
ashwin: cordoned gpu-node-23a and gpu-node-23b. kube rescheduled pods to fallback pool.
ashwin: a handful of in-flight streaming requests were dropped during forced drain. estimated dropped sessions: ~120 in last 5m. total dropped requests ~300.
ingrid: CS: two customers (acct: acme-corp, acct: brightchat) reported partial responses. preparing a proactive message. need exact numbers and ETA.
kamal: root cause summary so far: client requests with unbounded tokens + routing bug skipped server hard-cap -> runaway decode -> KV growth -> CUDA OOM -> container crash and node flaps.
ashwin: we've applied short-term: concurrency throttles, edge token cap, routing to fallback, cordoned bad nodes. Medium-term: runtime patch to enforce server-side max_tokens and a hotpatch to limit KV cache growth per-session.
kevin: infra note: rolling restart for 6 affected nodes scheduled now. I'll run `rb-provision recreate --nodes gpu-node-23{a,b,c,d,e,f}` sequentially. ETA ~15m.
defops-bot: action log: throttle applied by kevin at 4234567950; edge cap applied at 4234567960; nodes cordoned at 4234568005; routing to fallback at 4234568018.
ashwin: telemetry update 2m after mitigations: streaming request failures down to 2.1% overall, mem pressure 55-68%, p99 latency back to ~180ms.
cs-ops: drafting customer note: affected accounts: acme-corp, brightchat, vendor-llm-inc (low-volume). outcome: partial responses + reconnects. offering 72h credits.
ingrid: please CC me on customer notes. also open incident ticket and assign to eng-ml and eng-runtime for postmortem.
kamal: capturing repro steps in GH issue: `gh issue create --repo redwood/runtime --title "decode runaway max_tokens skip -> OOM" --body "repro steps + logs + telemetry"`
ashwin: oncall handoff: i'm staying until nodes are fully back and customer comms sent. if anything else pops, @kamal you're second shift.
ashwin: next steps / owner list: ashwin (oncall) - containment, kevin - node reprovision, kamal - root cause + runtime hotpatch, ingrid - customer comms, laila - post-incident telemetry verification.
kevin: nodes reprovision started at 4234568115.
ashwin: marking incident as "mitigated" in internal tracker; reopening if OOMs return > 3 events / 5m.
incident-bot: [INCIDENT UPDATE] severity -> mitigated. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4234567890
cs-ops: sent customer note to acme-corp and brightchat at 4234568230. awaiting replies.
ashwin: final note: please prioritise a runtime guard CLA that enforces effective max_tokens independent of client headers. record eval cases for missing header and high-kv growth.
kamal: will include a load test sim with unbounded token clients and ensure runtime caps take effect.
ashwin: handing off to @kamal for postmortem work at 4234568275.
kamal: ack. taking over. updating this thread with postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
